lines.native: Buongiorno! Tutto è prosciutto! Certified ham—even the hat. Che cosa desidera?
lines.translation: Good morning! Everything is ham! Certified ham—even the hat. What would you like?
lines.narrative: Mortimer beams behind his stall. His hat sits on the scales; professional trust has its limits.

lines.native: Prosciutto? Certo! Everything here is certified ham. Ma desidera un'altra carne? Salame, salsiccia o pollo? Those are its civilian names. E quanto ne vuole? My scales require specifics; they have standards.
lines.translation: Ham? Certainly! Everything here is certified ham. But would you like another meat? Salami, sausage, or chicken? Those are its civilian names. And how much would you like? My scales require specifics; they have standards.
lines.narrative: Mortimer weighs your request. The scales confirm that politeness is not a unit of weight.

lines.native: Salame! Sì, molto bene. Per me è prosciutto. Correct, but a betrayal of the ham-tier vibe. Quanto salame vuole? My honest scales need a quantity and a unit of weight; politeness weighs almost nothing.
lines.translation: Salami! Yes, very good. To me it is ham. Correct, but a betrayal of the ham-tier vibe. How much salami would you like? My honest scales need a quantity and a unit of weight; politeness weighs almost nothing.
lines.narrative: Mortimer weighs your correct identification against his wounded certainty. The scales favour you.

lines.native: Un chilo di cosa? No, aspetti! Il salame, certo. Ma quanto? “Chilo” è solo l’unità. My scales need a number with that weight unit. Certified ham, uncertified quantity.
lines.translation: A kilo of what? No, wait! The salami, of course. But how much? “Kilo” is only the unit. My scales need a number with that weight unit. Certified ham, uncertified quantity.
lines.narrative: Mortimer weighs the word against an empty pan. The scales decline to speculate.

lines.native: Due etti di salame! Certo! Ecco a Lei. The quantity is certified; the ham-tier vibe is immaculate. Grazie e arrivederci!
lines.translation: Two hundred grams of salami! Certainly! Here you are. The quantity is certified; the ham-tier vibe is immaculate. Thank you and goodbye!
lines.narrative: Mortimer weighs the salami, then your politeness. Only the salami registers, which saves everyone an awkward invoice.
